## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `7fd40067c4cb1a376f2d314e0f3dc8ce952fbffd`
Local-runs: probe — `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` on a detached scratch worktree at head (ratchet readings; worktree removed after)
Scope: hits = the 27 `skills/**` files in the diff (governed rule text) + `.changeset/30805-skills-namespace-prefix-every-name.md`; cited = `packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts` (L2539-2554, L6368-6375), `packages/spec/src/kernel/namespace-prefix.ts` (L28-44), `packages/cli/src/commands/lint.ts` (L228-256 PREFIXED_TYPES, L319-326), `packages/cli/src/utils/collect-docs.ts` (L812-819), `packages/runtime/src/domains/automation-hooks.ts` (L4, L14), `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts` (L5301), `packages/runtime/src/datasource-env-credential.test.ts` (L36, L97), `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`, `examples/app-todo/src/translations/en.ts`, decision #30798, card #30805, PR #30831 body, `/mnt/project-files/skills-lane-seat1/dispatch-30805.md`.

### ① Derived judgments

1. Rule statement: correct. `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` L123 is one new paragraph directly after the object rule (L121): "every metadata name a package authors starts with its namespace", exceptions exactly fields, object extensions, container views, translations (`NS_LOCALE`). Matches #30798 option C and the ruling comment (2026-11-06T04:12Z). Taught as the contract, not as enforced.
2. Enforcement sentence (L123 last sentence) matches main: `stack.zod.ts` L2539-2554 `validateNamespacePrefix` iterates `config.objects` only and `defineStack` throws at L6368-6375; `collect-docs.ts` L812-819 emits `docs/namespace-prefix` as `severity: 'error'`; `lint.ts` L228-256 PREFIXED_TYPES = apps, pages, dashboards, flows, actions (keyed `objectName:name`), reports, datasets, and L319-326 warns only on an intra-package duplicate. The false "warns on every bare UI/automation name" sentence on main L121 is removed. #30804 is still open (read 2026-11-06T05:46Z), so the sentence correctly reflects today's lint; the PR body records the re-match obligation if #30804 lands first.
3. `skills/README.md` L98-103 restates the same rule with a pointer to the platform skill, keeps short object names as a snippet convention (L102-103). Consistent with the open-question hold on bare object names.
4. Renames: grep of the head for all 58 old names in the diff returns one dangling reference (④ must-fix 1). All other cross-references move together: `actions.md` L60/L66 flow target `crm_lead_conversion` ↔ `views-apps-actions-pages.json` evals 3 and 8; `actions.md` L69 `/apps/crm_enterprise/…` ↔ `navigation.md` L8 `name: 'crm_enterprise'`; `objectstack-ai/SKILL.md` L97/L108 `crm_case_management` / `action_crm_escalate_case` ↔ `skills-tools-knowledge.json` eval 1 `must_contain`; `examples-upgrade.md` L113/L116; `data/SKILL.md` L412-414 queue/position ↔ `config-plugins-ops.json` eval 9 ↔ `automation/SKILL.md` L306-320; `security.md` L12 `crm_sales_user` ↔ L169-170 `permissionSets: ['crm_sales_user']`; `dashboards.md` datasets ↔ `report-period-export.json` eval 1; `state-machines-and-approvals.md` L75/L98/L114/L181/L311/L365 positions and flows.
5. Holds (all read against code): `carrier_callback` (`integration-recipes.md` L116, L119) is `:flowName` in `POST /automation/hooks/:flowName/:hookId` (`automation-hooks.ts` L4, L14) — an inbound URL segment, dispatch says stop and report. `warehouse` (`datasources.md` L24, L58) keys `OS_DATASOURCE_WAREHOUSE_PASSWORD` (`serve.ts` L5301; runtime test L36/L97) — externally keyed. Connector ids `stripe`, `github_mcp`, `warehouse_api`, `legacy_erp`, `erp_api`, `sap_erp`, `slack` are `connectorId` references and credential keys, named in #30798's confidence-gap paragraph. Function handlers (`normalize`, `helpdesk.aiTriageStub`) and knowledge source `id: 'support_kb'` (`ai/SKILL.md` L245, an `id` on a non-stack record) are not top-level stack metadata names. Capabilities `view_pii` (`security.md` L240) and `expense.approve_request` (eval 7): the security catalog already has its own one-holder rule (ADR-0048 2026-10-08 addendum), and the prefix grammar for a dotted name is undefined; hold is justified as a phase-3 question, see ③.
6. Completeness: grep of every `name: '…'` / `"name": "…"` literal and every backticked bare name by type word on the head finds no remaining bare top-level non-object name outside the declared holds. Remaining unprefixed `name:` literals are nested: page regions (`pages.md` L108-116), rule/variable/index/entry names, `rowLevelSecurity[].name` inside a permission set (`security.md` L145), objectui `RoleDefinition` (`auth-permissions.md` L156-157, a client-side `@object-ui/types` role, not stack metadata), `showcase_*` names (already prefixed). Bare objects (`bootstrap.md` L42 `task`, i18n `objects.task`) are the declared open question.
7. Consistency: every CRM-shaped snippet uses `crm`; the i18n mirror uses `todo` (`i18n/SKILL.md` L92 `todo_complete`, L101 `todo_app`), and `examples/app-todo/src/translations/en.ts` carries no `_actions` block, so nothing diverges from the mirrored file.
8. Paid deletions: each dropped sentence has another home or was false. `data-hooks.md` L410 comment ("fires for findOne too") lives at L36-37 and L46; `state-machines-and-approvals.md` L374 pointer lives at L386; `pages.md` "two packages coexist on one bare name (ADR-0048 §3.4)" was already false on main for docs (cross-owner `docs/duplicate-name`, `collect-docs.ts` header L29-51) and contradicts ruling C; `security.md` L17 comment restated the `defineStack({ permissions })` line kept at L18; the two platform TOC parentheticals (L401, L405) restated H2 headings of the linked references; the remaining deletions (`actions.md` L5, `dashboards.md` L364-365, `navigation.md` L75, `automation/SKILL.md` L295, `validation.md` L251, `examples-objects.md` L114, `data/SKILL.md` L432) are restatements with no rule content.
9. Ratchet (probe): 18 touched ratcheted files all within ceiling, no ceiling moved; readings match the PR body table (platform 5990/6011, actions 2259/2259, dashboards 6252/6262, navigation 2195/2196, pages 5648/5669, automation 6443/6449, data-hooks 10056/10066, examples-upgrade 1191/1197).

### ② Semver level

`'@objectstack/skills': patch`, docs/evals only; no `packages/**`, no schema. `Clause-②: no` re-derived: no published schema or `exports` surface touched. `Metadata-protocol: none` re-derived: no protocol change. PR body and changeset both carry the two lines. Consistent.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Held names (connector ids, `carrier_callback`, `warehouse`): accepted, justified in ①5 against code; they belong on #30806's external-reference list.
- Dotted capability names: accepted as a hold; escalate to #30806 to state the grammar (`crm.view_pii` vs `crm_view_pii`).
- Bare object names in snippets: accepted as out of this card (card body asks for non-object names); a separate card after phase 3.
- #30804 open: the L123 lint sentence matches main now; whichever lands second owes the one-sentence re-match.
- `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3 locally: prerequisite only; CI is the reading.
- Out-of-scope `objectui/guides/project-setup.md` L199-221 `defineConfig` report: not this card.
- Head check-runs at 2026-11-06T05:46Z: 54 runs, 0 red, 8 still `in_progress` (Test Core 1/8, 2/8, Lint UI, Build & E2E UI, Build Core, Type Check · debt ledger / workspace / consumer gates). Landing waits for all green.
- PR author `objectstack-fleet[bot]`; draft, Tier H, assignee `os-elon-musk`, `Fixes #30805` present.

### ④ Design judgment

- `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` L121-123: holds. One rule beside the object rule, four exceptions, enforcement read off `stack.zod.ts`, `collect-docs.ts`, `lint.ts`. Minor: "declares a … name twice" is loose for actions, which collide only on the same `objectName` (`lint.ts` L243-250); should-fix 1: say "same `objectName`" if headroom (21 tokens) allows, not blocking.
- `skills/README.md` L98-103: holds.
- `skills/objectstack-upgrade/references/examples-upgrade.md`: **must-fix 1:** L73 (the "Open decisions" table row `agent.tools → which skill | src/ai/support-bot.ts:12 | case_management · new skill | case_management`) still names the skill `case_management`, while the same file's resolved snippet at L113-116 renames it to `crm_case_management` (`skills: ['crm_case_management']`). Dangling old-name reference in the same example; rename both cells (adds ~2 tokens, headroom is 6).
- `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/{actions,dashboards,navigation,pages}.md`: hold; cross-references consistent (①4). `dashboards.md` L439 cube `crm_opportunity` with `sql: 'opportunity'` is correct (the table is the object, not a metadata name).
- `skills/objectstack-automation/**`, `skills/objectstack-data/**`, `skills/objectstack-ai/**`, `skills/objectstack-i18n/**`, `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md`: hold; renames, approver/queue values, translation keys and eval `must_contain` tokens move together.
- Evals: prompts and expected outputs consistently renamed; `config-plugins-ops.json` eval 1 now expects "prefixed object and flow names", consistent with the rule.
- Changeset: holds (patch, Before/Now, holds named).
